verdict.rationale: Requesty is itself a documented public API: an OpenAI-compatible base URL (router.requesty.ai/v1) with documented Chat Completions, Messages, Responses and Images endpoints, plus API-level features such as prompt_id references and structured outputs. The docs are also agent-readable through llms.txt and markdown pages. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), and evidence of a programmatic management API for configuring policies, keys, service accounts or MCP servers, which the docs describe only as features without an admin endpoint.
